title: Chroma Guard
theme: Abstract geometric creatures of shifting colors approach a central crystal; place color-matching wardens to repel them
mechanics: Place color-matching towers to repel approaching creatures
Survive waves of increasingly fast creatures
Earn points between waves to place and upgrade towers

controls.action: Set current tower color to red
Set current tower color to blue
Set current tower color to green
Set current tower color to yellow
Place selected tower at click position
